purpose: Carry the V15 real visit-validation programme onto V14c without reintroducing the invalid implication low target evidence + good observation support => biological target absence.

state_semantics.T: positive evidence for focal insect/visit process
state_semantics.O: primary-stream measurement support for attempting interpretation
state_semantics.A_minus: independently validated target-absence evidence; optional and not yet field validated
state_semantics.U: unresolved inference retained when positive/negative evidence or attribution is insufficient

hard_rules: O is independent of N and is not 1-N
a low or zero score from the positive target observer cannot be inverted into absence evidence
O=observable plus low target evidence remains unresolved unless A_minus supports absence
A_minus must name a source and validation reference independent of the positive target path
unobservable O censors biological positive/negative inference even when A_minus exists
the full system uses the V14b process-preserving target+nuisance policy rather than the historical V14a conflict policy
simultaneous high T and N is legitimate superposition and remains target-positive with nuisance audit when O is adequate
forced negative calls from intentionally naive comparison architectures are recorded separately from certified absence evidence

comparison_interpretation.direct_target_only_naive: may emit forced_absence_call from low target score; never counts this as certified negative evidence
comparison_interpretation.direct_plus_coupled_target_without_nuisa: may emit forced_absence_call; no safe absence inference because O/A_minus are unavailable
comparison_interpretation.target_plus_nuisance_without_support_gat: may emit forced_absence_call when nuisance does not warn; no safe absence inference because O is unavailable
comparison_interpretation.target_plus_support_without_nuisance: can certify absence only when O is observable and A_minus is independently supported; otherwise low target evidence remains U
comparison_interpretation.full_direct_coupled_target_nuisance_obse: can certify absence only when the triad reaches a quiet-observable historical negative condition and A_minus independently supports absence; otherwise the window remains U

current_absence_channel_status.interpretation: Until a genuinely independent absence channel is validated, V15 may validate presence detection and observation support but must not claim calibrated biological absence from non-detection.

freeze_before_heldout: whether A_minus exists; if yes, its independent measurement and held-out validation protocol

claim_boundary.allowed_now: software and semantic readiness on current main only
forbidden_now: universal superiority of the full system
